title: Wafer-on-Wafer 3D Integration
summary: Wafer-on-wafer stacking with micron-pitch vertical interconnects, used to bond memory and logic dies into one stack.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

Full wafer stacking with micron-pitch vertical interconnects; TSMC SoIC-X.

Pilot deployments and early-stage commercial testing underway. Technology is proven at small scale. Our research database tracks 6 independent sources on this technology.

AMD 3D V-Cache (Milan-X, Genoa-X, Ryzen X3D) uses TSMC SoIC wafer-on-wafer bonding for cache stacking — shipping millions of units since 2021. Sony stacked CMOS image sensors using WoW bonding in all smartphone cameras. TSMC SoIC now expanding to logic-on-logic stacking for AI accelerators.

businessMeaning: Stacking trades package complexity for bandwidth and area, so adoption depends on whether the system-level gain beats the cost of known-good-die testing and thermal design.
investmentLens: Hybrid bonding and wafer-level test tooling are the picks-and-shovels; the memory makers with captive stacking capacity hold the strongest position.
